record.question: The {{Epithelial_ESCC.RDS} file is single-cell transcriptome data of malignant epithelial cells from esophageal cancer obtained using 10X Genomics single-cell RNA sequencing technology. The file was created using R language and the Seurat package. This dataset includes patients who have developed resistance to various new adjuvant therapies, as well as patients who underwent pure surgical treatment for comparison. Please perform reasonable clustering of all cells in this data and analyze the top 10 highly expressed genes and marker genes for each cluster.
